model: ROLEX Sea-Dweller Deepsea 136660 D-Blue (44 mm steel, black-to-deep-blue gradient dial, black Cerachrom Ringlock bezel with coin edge, date without Cyclops, Oyster bracelet with Glidelock end)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Sea-Dweller Deepsea 44: ADAPT of the Sea-Dweller 43 build (same step, spec driven; own prep copy only for the file-name prefix), everything re-measured on the 136660 photo (44 mm = coin-edge tip diameter, 22.59 px/mm, pivot (960, 1422)). Case and lugs with the crown guards from the photo silhouette, ceramic insert + polished rim + 60-flute coin-edge ring, domed crystal, traced hand outlines, fluted crown, the three-column Oyster bracelet at the photo's joints; NO Cyclops lens (the date window with the 28 is photo texture); dial (D-Blue gradient, DEEPSEA in green, indices, print), the bezel numerals / scale / lume pearl / reflection and the photographed hands come from one native photo map or the projected steel photo. The helium escape valve (9 o'clock flank) is not visible in this front render (nothing in the silhouette), so it has no mesh. Native 1920 x 2857 photo, no texture scaling.
